limitations: User-mode emulation shares the host Linux kernel and does not qualify physical board firmware, native throughput, or full guest kernel integration.

The broad selection deselected 24 complete_spectra_user_accuracy_contract cases and 8 long_segment_batches_and_csd_fallback_use_corrected_statistics cases with prohibitively slow emulated long-double reference arithmetic. Other short, streaming, disk, prepared and corrected-statistics cases were executed.
The first fast.13 baseline runs were deliberately interrupted and are retained separately. Their partial passes are not included as successful qualifications or added to coverage counts.

The final union is latest-status evidence across the completed broad run, final FFT run, final build-provenance selection, and final platform-memory ABI fixture module, not a single full-suite execution. Repeated IDs count once.
